I posted the answer in #coastal-team, addressed to you.

The last figure posted there for Saltmarsh Provisions is 10%. Bettina first wrote 12% on 17 Nov 2025, then retracted it the same day and corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread June Osei-Lark's draft worksheet. I couldn't find a signed order form or amendment in what I can see, so 10% is the latest posted number, not a confirmed contract term. Before it goes in the renewal brief, check the signed paperwork or ask June Osei-Lark to confirm.
